drums.tags: Funk rock instrumental featuring a prominent slap bass lead. The bass utilizes percussive thumb slaps and finger pops, executing a syncopated sixteenth-note riff with frequent chromatic slides and hammer-ons. A clean electric guitar provides rhythmic accompaniment with staccato 9th chord stabs on the offbeats. The drum kit maintains a steady groove with a crisp snare on beats 2 and 4, active hi-hat sixteenth-note patterns, and a syncopated kick drum that locks with the bass line. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the percussive transients of the strings. 105 BPM, E Dorian.

[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[percussive slap bass riff enters, sixteenth-note syncopation]
[clean electric guitar enters with staccato chord stabs]
[drum kit enters, tight snare, closed hi-hat patterns]

[Main Theme]
[bass performs melodic slides and pops]
[guitar continues rhythmic scratching and offbeat accents]
[kick drum follows bass accents]

[Bridge]
[bass shifts to lower register pedal tones]
[hi-hat opens slightly for accents]

[Outro]
[bass riff intensifies with rapid pops]
[final sustained E minor 9 chord on guitar]
[drum fill ends on crash cymbal]

bass.tags: Body percussion and tap dance performance. The piece is built entirely on rhythmic sounds produced by the human body and footwear on a resonant wooden surface. It features rhythmic stomping, syncopated hand claps, chest pops, and intricate tap shoe footwork including shuffles, flaps, and heel-toe clicks. The tempo is 120 BPM. The structure begins with a steady quarter-note pulse established by stomps, followed by polyrhythmic layers of clapping and rapid-fire tap sequences. The performance utilizes call-and-response patterns between different percussive textures. The dynamics vary from soft toe taps to heavy, resonant stomps that exploit the natural reverb of the wooden floor. There are no melodic or harmonic instruments.
